title: AffineModuleTensorBaseChange
statement: Let $f:U\to X$ be a scheme morphism, $A=f_*O_U$, $r_0:f^{-1}O_X\to O_U$ its structure map and $t_0:f^{-1}O_X\to f^{-1}A$ the inverse-image algebra map. For any pushout with maps $b:O_U\to B$, $t:f^{-1}A\to B$, there is a functor $P(G)=B\otimes_{f^{-1}A}f^{-1}G$ with the sheafified tensor map formula and a natural isomorphism $\kappa:P\operatorname{Res}_b\simeq Sf^*$. On the canonical pullback unit, its inverse gives the sheafification of $1\otimes\eta(g)$ for every local section $g$. Here $S$ is scalar restriction along $O_X\to A$. Conventions: [def-pc-scheme], [pqf-def-affine-morphism], [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], [pqf-def-coherent], [def-pc-module-pullback], [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product], [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction].

proof.text: Construct the inverse-image functor using inverseImageModuleMap, and the scalar-extension functor using changeOfRingsHom. Their identities and composition follow from the abelian inverse-image, sectionwise extension-of-scalars and sheafification functor laws. Their composite P has exactly the required objects and map formula.

Compare the inverse-image module of Res_ρ G with Res_(inverse-image ρ)(inverse-image G). Their abelian sheaves are definitionally identical. For the two scalar actions, the inverse-image unit formulas and naturality of the ring unit give equality on unit images; inverseImageOperation_ext extends equality to every open. The identity abelian maps therefore form mutually inverse linear maps, natural in G.

Apply sheafTensorPushoutCancellation to r₀,t₀,b,t and I(G). Its naturality assembles the objectwise comparisons into a natural isomorphism. Compose with scalar extension of the inverse-image/scalar-restriction isomorphism to obtain κ. For the unit, rewrite by the chosen tensorPullbackAdjunction unit formula, apply sheafification-unit naturality and reduce extension of scalars on a pure tensor, and use the identity action of the inverse-image comparison and the cancellation inverse formula.

theorem affine_module_tensor_baseChange
    (B : U.toTopCat.Sheaf CommRingCat.{u}) (b : U.sheaf ⟶ B) (t : IA ⟶ B)
    (hpush : IsPushout r₀ t₀ b t) :
      ∃ (P : SheafOfModules.{u} (𝓡 A) ⥤ SheafOfModules.{u} (𝓡 B))
        (pobj : ∀ G, P.obj G = SheafOfModules.changeOfRings.{u, u, u} t (I G))
        (κ : P ⋙ SheafOfModules.restrictScalars (𝓻 b) ≅ S ⋙ tensorPullback f),
        (∀ (G G' : SheafOfModules.{u} (𝓡 A)) (a : G ⟶ G'),
          P.map a = eqToHom (pobj G) ≫
            SheafOfModules.changeOfRingsHom.{u, u, u} t (I G)
              (TopCat.Sheaf.inverseImageModuleMap f.base A G a) ≫
            eqToHom (pobj G').symm) ∧
        (∀ (G : SheafOfModules.{u} (𝓡 A)) (V : (Opens X)ᵒᵖ) (g : G.val.obj V),
          ((eqToHom (pobj G)).val.app ((Opens.map f.base).op.obj V))
            ((κ.inv.app G).val.app ((Opens.map f.base).op.obj V)
              (((adj₀).unit.app ((S).obj G)).val.app V g)) =
            ((PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction (𝟙 (𝓡 B).obj)).unit.app
              (SheafOfModules.changeOfRingsPresheaf.{u, u, u} t (I G))).app
                ((Opens.map f.base).op.obj V)
                ((1 : B.obj.obj ((Opens.map f.base).op.obj V)) ⊗ₜ[
                  (IA).obj.obj ((Opens.map f.base).op.obj V),
                  (t.hom.app ((Opens.map f.base).op.obj V)).hom]
                  (((Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafAdjunctionContinuous
                    (Opens.map f.base) AddCommGrpCat.{u} (𝓙 X) (𝓙 U)).unit.app
                      ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf (𝓡 A)).obj G)).hom.app V g)))
